name: Little N's Camera
descriptionTemplate:
{Golden Harmony}: {Arithmetica Harmony} now only increases Arithmetica Cost by 1. Each 1% DMG Amplification increases {Occult Research} Depth by 1%.
{Transit Fatigue}: All HP recovery effects -50% in battle. When "Burial" is selected at "Faded Bones," the effect changes to restore 25% Max HP.
lore: Look no further—this is the one! Brand new, factory-fresh, and guaranteed to satisfy.
